description: Zeck release promotion policy (WORK-047 / D-06). Repository truth for the CLOSED gate-kind vocabulary and the promotion entry gates per ladder phase. The ladder order and the per-phase requirements of environments.json remain the single source of truth for the ladder: this policy must COVER every environments.json promotion requirement (validated fail-closed at load time and by deploy:validate — drift is unrepresentable). CI/CD, provider control planes and dashboards drive this policy through the governed release-control store; they never redefine it.

gateKinds.evidence: scripts/governance-check.py exit 0 at the exact release revision (the repository governance gate).
tsc --noEmit exit 0 at the exact release revision.
biome check . exit 0 at the exact release revision.
The full vitest suite exit 0 at the exact release revision (real PostgreSQL where the suite requires it).
The repository CI workflows concluded successfully at the exact release revision (workflow name, run id, conclusion, head sha — externally attached by CI).
deploy:validate valid at the exact release revision (manifests, naming, port contracts, secret scan, release policy, quota guards).
The deterministic deployment identity recomputes and matches the recorded environment binding (drift/tampering detection).

The target environment's migration ledger is converged with the release revision's shipped set: no unapplied shipped migration, no applied-but-unshipped migration (downgrade hazard), checksums intact; the ordered ledger digest is recorded.
The readiness evaluation of the target environment is 'ready' (control plane up, the authoritative PostgreSQL dependency ready, non-authoritative dependencies ready).
deploy:smoke attestation passed for the preview environment at the exact release revision (identity + environment contract + readiness).
deploy:smoke attestation passed for the staging environment at the exact release revision.
The explicit, recorded Architect approval for promoting this exact release to production (approver identity + statement). Worker tooling records it; it never fabricates it.
The environment deployment binding passes the identity re-verification at promotion time (the environments.json staging requirement, bound to the identity-audit evaluator).
